science.title: Chronobiology applied to your trip
science.p1: Light is the main synchronizer of the body clock. Depending on the biological time at which it is received, it advances or delays that clock.
science.p2: That is why exposure to light at the wrong time can slow down adaptation to the new time zone. Fuseo uses your route, the direction of travel and your usual sleep hours to determine the relevant windows.
science.prcTitle: Same light, opposite effect depending on timing
science.delayText: delays the clock (useful when flying west)
science.advanceText: advances the clock (useful when flying east)
science.prcNote: The “biological morning” follows your internal clock, not local time: right after a long flight, it can fall in the middle of the afternoon.

footer.disclaimer: Fuseo provides general information and advice on sleep and travel chronobiology. The service is not a medical consultation, does not make a diagnosis and does not replace the advice of a healthcare professional. It is intended for healthy adults. If you are pregnant, have a chronic illness, bipolar disorder, an eye disease or are undergoing treatment, ask your doctor before following a plan.

team.storyLead: Medical expertise, now accessible to all travelers.
team.story1: It all began at the Institut Médical du Sommeil in Paris.
team.story2: In our practice, we worked with people facing exceptional demands: elite athletes, executives, frequent international travelers, and patients for whom jet lag was a real difficulty.
team.story3: They all asked the same question: how can I arrive feeling well instead of spending the first days recovering?
team.story4: We saw that advice to sleep on the plane or get daylight was not enough. Jet lag is more complex. Light at the wrong time, a poorly timed nap or unsuitable advice can delay adjustment of the body clock.
team.story5: AI can produce recommendations in seconds, but it does not by itself guarantee that they make sense in chronobiological terms.
team.story7: For months, we studied scientific models of the body clock, compared approaches, examined their limits and designed an algorithm to turn that knowledge into personal guidance.
team.story8: Our aim was simple: make this expertise available beyond the few travelers receiving specialist support.
team.story9: Why not let everyone benefit from it?
team.story10: That is how Fuseo was born.
team.scienceBehindText: Our method explains the scientific models and chronobiology principles behind each plan.
